messages.author: 70abc85dd4bcb117
messages.subject: Strange Error
parts:
I successfully ran my first Stan model, using RStudio and rstan.  First I ran the example in the rstan documentation...worked great. They I created my own model fitting a poisson model with weibull heterogeneity to some data I had.  Ran it with 2000 iterations and then with 20,000 iterations. Great results again.  Then I modified the model to have gamma heterogeneity instead.  I ran into an error....but the error seems to be unrelated to the model. Now, no models (including the example or the previously successful models) will run. The attached file gives the output and the system seems unable to open some required file.  Any ideas would be appreciated.  Using rstan 1.0.3

# using library inline to compile a C++ code on the fly
library(inline) 

library(Rcpp)
src <- ' 

  std::vector<std::string> s; 
  s.push_back("hello");
  s.push_back("world");
  return Rcpp::wrap(s);
'
hellofun <- cxxfunction(body = src, includes = '', plugin = 'Rcpp', verbose = FALSE)
